The background includes pine trees and the white sky. (10) A zoom sequence focusing on a large Ferris wheel in the distance. The woman is seen inside one of the red gondolas, waving to the camera. The editing uses speed ramps to transition between the zoom levels quickly. (11) The woman walks into a colorful indoor amusement area. She passes a carousel with horses and bright lights. She is then seen riding the carousel, smiling and waving. The lighting shifts to warm artificial indoor lights. (12) The final montage shows the woman posing near a large pink Christmas tree decorated with silver ornaments. She sits on a bench and makes a heart gesture. Text overlays appear at the bottom of the frame throughout.
